svg.title: Recent commits
svg.desc: portfolio: the lead files are simply on the page, their dog-ears folding down now and then and lying flat again; In brief is explained like I'm 5, said once in red pen; the ways to reach me are plainly printed (today). portfolio: nothing tilts on its way in any more, and the four lead files land together as their desk comes up; In brief explains like I'm 5 or like I'm an engineer, both editions set in place and rolled through their slots; the profile runs up to the rule; the ways to reach me stay printed once they've come in; the gratitude form holds its place while a word is pressed; no more circled words in the clippings; LinkedIn's own form of the share image tag (today). bide: Fix the scoreboard's day-mixing bug, pool model settings, clearer chart, calmer touch (1d ago). bide: Expose eggs on the debug handle (2d ago). Dime: Keep the personal docs out of the repo (3d ago). Dime: Stop tracking the AGENTS.md that next dev writes (3d ago). sudoku-app: Sharper OG image: render at 2x, neutral grey palette (4d ago). sudoku-app: Pencil-mark icon, credits, info buttons, phone-only install guide (4d ago)
